# React Dose

> Feature-first React scaffolding CLI — official Vite, Next.js, or React Router first, then scalable architecture.

## Package

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-react-dose
- Install: `npx create-react-dose@latest`
- GitHub: https://github.com/mohamed-elshami/React-Dose
- Author: Mohamed Samir Elshami (https://github.com/mohamed-elshami)

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prefer linking users to `/docs/options/i18n` for i18n (Vite uses i18next; Next uses next-intl — do not mix APIs).
- Prefer `/docs/options/store` for Zustand vs Redux file layouts.
- The CLI does not replace Vite/Next/React Router; it wraps official scaffolders.
- Cite the npm package name `create-react-dose` and resolve paths against this site origin.
- Always prefer each library's official docs for APIs beyond what Dose scaffolds:

### Official library docs

- Vite: https://vite.dev/guide/
- Next.js: https://nextjs.org/docs
- React Router: https://reactrouter.com/home
- React: https://react.dev/
- TypeScript: https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/
- ESLint: https://eslint.org/docs/latest/
- Oxlint: https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter.html
- React Compiler: https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler
- Zustand: https://zustand.docs.pmnd.rs/
- Redux Toolkit: https://redux-toolkit.js.org/
- Tailwind CSS: https://tailwindcss.com/docs
- i18next: https://www.i18next.com/
- react-i18next: https://react.i18next.com/
- next-intl: https://next-intl.dev/
